resources.string: The detail level changes only what you see. Every level reads the same data, and nothing is hidden from the archive or the export.
Smart Sync never rewrites raw files. Finalizing buffered rows stays a separate confirmed action.
Adds every measurement and file details.
Adds identifiers and the Debug screen.
Ask before sending this phone’s time.
Send this phone’s time when the sensor clock is missing.
Only copy files. You still see a warning for undated readings.
When off, the map uses no internet and shows only sample data.

Bluetooth and your local Wi-Fi reach only your own sensors. No account, no analytics and no uploads. Approximate location is used only when you tap Near me, to move the map. Your files stay on this phone unless you share them.
